title: Kalkulator Profit
description: Compare crop profit berdasarkan plot count, session length, dan star bonus.
useCase: Pilih the best crop sebelum planting.

title: Pelacak Ikan
description: Lacak langka fish catches berdasarkan water rute, level gate, dan time condition.

title: Perencana Tanaman
description: Buat an aktif, seimbang, atau offline crop rute dari playtime dan plot count.
useCase: Ubah a play window into a planting schedule.

title: Pelacak Pertemanan
description: Perkirakan NPC routine progres dari gifts, talks, dan hangouts.
useCase: Plan one relationship loop untuk the week.

title: Pencari Resep
description: Saring starter recipes berdasarkan ingredients you already have.
useCase: Pilih what to cook sebelum selling atau gifting.

title: Checklist Harian
description: Simpan a repeatable harian rute dengan presets untuk codes, crops, fish, dan NPC.

title: Timer Rute
description: Run persistent timers untuk crops, cooking, memancing windows, dan toko centang.
useCase: Know when to return to a rute.
